title: Stream Data Source
text: Generate continuous stream data, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Data type} sets Output data type; {Dimensions} sets the output data dimensions, {Burst length} sets the length of single burst, {Total bursts} sets the total number of bursts, {Data generation} sets the output generation type, {Counter init value} sets the initial counter value, {Variable name} sets the workspace, {Sample time} sets the time interval of sampling and {Transfer delay (in samples)} sets the delay between bursts. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Data type
params.values: Output data type uint8 (default) | double | single | int8 | int16 | int32 | int64 | uint16 | uint32 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Dimensions
params.values: Output data dimensions 10 (default) | positive integer | array

params.name: Burst length
params.values: Length of single burst 20 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Total bursts
params.values: Total number of bursts 4 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Data generation
params.values: Output generation type counter (default) | random | ones | workspace

params.name: Variable name
params.values: Workspace variable name simOut (default) | any MATLAB supported variable name

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Time interval of sampling 1 (default) | positive scalar | vector
